data_requirement.model: 2-descriptor OLS (intercept + B + n_x), p=3, the minimum the governing physics needs
data_requirement.reading: The <=25 C gate is co-gated: (C1) a protocol-controlled set of n>=12 (ideally ~20) to make the LOO trustworthy, AND (C2) a third steric/side-group descriptor (or nonlinearity) to lower the ~26 C linear-model structural floor. Neither alone suffices.

two_binding_constraints.C1_leverage_data_scarcity: At n=7 the 3-param model burns 43% of its DoF on leverage (mean hat=0.43), inflating held-out error ~1.32x over the in-sample sigma -- which is why the 2-axis LOO (48.96 C) is WORSE than the 1-axis LOO (35.73 C) even though the 2-axis IN-SAMPLE fit is tighter than the 1-axis in-sample fit. By n>=12 the inflation falls to ~1.15x and by n>=20 to ~1.08x, so n>=12 (G1) is the minimum for a LOO that reflects model SKILL rather than leverage.
two_binding_constraints.C2_model_structural_error: HONEST CEILING: the linear B+n_x in-sample RMSE is already 26.0 C (R2 0.55) at n=7 -- essentially AT the <=25 C gate. More protocol-consistent data DE-LEVERAGES the LOO but cannot push a LINEAR 2-descriptor model below its own ~26 C in-sample structural error, which is dominated by systems a linear B+n_x cannot encode: the DDS aromatic-sulfone rigidity (under-fit) and the IPDA gem-dimethyl STERIC boost (v3's diagnosed missing axis). So crossing <=25 C requires a steric/side-group descriptor OR a nonlinear model IN ADDITION to more data.

gate_feasibility.conclusion: The <=25 C G2 gate lies ABOVE the ~8.6 C same-protocol inter-lab floor (=> achievable in principle) but BELOW the 27-46 C cross-cure-state scatter of a single amine (=> UNACHIEVABLE on any dataset that mixes cure states). Therefore the network-Tg Phase-0 KPI is gated on protocol-CONSISTENT curation, not merely on rights-clean data VOLUME: a model trained on protocol-mixed open-literature Tg cannot reach <=25 C no matter how good it is, because the LABELS themselves disagree by more than the gate.

honest_limitations: n=7 protocol-consistent unique systems is UNCHANGED; still below the n>=12 G1 gate.
the cold-cure evidence (IPDA 112, DDS 181) is a REFERENCE-hardener datum, not a full cure map; it bounds the cure-state effect but is not itself a merged training label.
the leverage inflation figures are mean-leverage OLS approximations, not a substitute for a real learning curve, which requires the very data that is missing.
protocol consistency is necessary but not sufficient: a real dataset must also fix DSC rate and (mid-point vs onset) Tg convention, which add further scatter if uncontrolled.

The 2-axis IN-SAMPLE R2 is only 0.547 (RMSE 26.0 C): the two descriptors capture the crosslink-density and stiffness axes but a LINEAR B+n_x still leaves ~45% of in-sample variance unexplained (DDS sulfone rigidity, IPDA gem-dimethyl sterics). verdict: PROTOCOL_CURATION_AND_MODEL_CO_LIMITED (NOT a Phase-0 promotion). This run sharpens the prior 'just acquire n>=12' framing into TWO quantified, decision-relevant findings. FINDING 1 (new, from page-verified CC-BY evidence): the SAME amine's Tg shifts 27-46 C purely with cure state (IPDA full 158 vs cold 112; DDS post-cured 208 vs hot-cure ref 181) -- LARGER than the <=25 C G2 gate. The gate sits ABOVE the ~8.6 C same-protocol inter-lab floor but BELOW the 27-46 C cross-cure-state scatter, so the network-Tg KPI is achievable ONLY on a protocol-CONTROLLED rights-clean dataset; naive aggregation of open-literature Tg (which mixes cure states) can never reach it. FINDING 2 (honest ceiling): the two governing non-circular descriptors B (1-axis LOO 35.73 C) and Flory n_x are in hand, but their LINEAR combination already has ~26 C in-sample RMSE (R2 0.55) at n=7 -- so more data DE-LEVERAGES the LOO yet cannot cross <=25 C without a steric/side-group descriptor (IPDA gem-dimethyl; DDS sulfone) or a nonlinear model. Concrete spec to close the gap: (a) >=5 additional fully-post-cured DGEBA + DISCRETE-amine Tg points under ONE declared cure protocol + ONE DSC rate (n>=12, ideally ~20), AND (b) a third steric descriptor. 0 new points merged this run -- all fetchable rights-clean candidates failed protocol/discreteness/access screens (logged). Founder takeaway: network-Tg is the highest-value gap, its physics is understood, and it is blocked by protocol-consistent data curation PLUS one more descriptor, NOT by governance.
